Name: Mount Halak
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the south, toward Seir
Description: The mountain that marked the southern end of Joshua's conquests, on the way up to Seir. Joshua's campaigns are measured from Baal-gad in the north to Mount Halak in the south.
BiblicalSignificance: Halak bounds the land Joshua took, from the Lebanon valley to the edge of Seir.
